title: Riffle
description: A flat flip book of the Beatles' twelve studio albums, one cover per page from Please Please Me to Let It Be. Drag sideways to riffle the pages forwards or back at your own speed, or let it turn one page at a time; each page folds flat over the spine with no perspective.
intent: One physical object read straight-on: clean, undistorted pages of real album art that fold flat over the spine one by one, so the speed of your drag is how fast seven years go by.
